name: bld5_carleman_sqrt_two_rec_defect
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2 - a i)) ^ (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Real.pi ^ 2
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2 - a i)) ^ (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ Real.pi ^ 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_carleman_finite_three, Mathlib2.bld3_sqrt_two_rec_defect_tsum_bounds, Mathlib2.bld2_sqrt_two_rec_defect_summable and Mathlib2.ana_sqrt_two_rec_lt_two: the defects 2 − a_i are non-negative (ana_sqrt_two_rec_lt_two), so Carleman's inequality with constant 3 (bld4) bounds the sum of geometric means by 3·∑_{k<n}(2 − a_k) ≤ 3·∑'(2 − a_k) (sum_le_tsum with bld2 summability) ≤ 3·π²/3 = π² (bld3).
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), a 0 = 0 → (∀ (n : ℕ), a (n + 1) = √(2 + a n)) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (2 - a i)) ^ (1 / (↑k + 1)) ≤ Real.pi ^ 2
